boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Ten documented no-admission places and activities for a low-key day out from Tulane.

cards.title: Browse Newcomb Art Museum
cards.subtitle: Woldenberg Art Center, Tulane Uptown Campus
cards.notes: Meet at the museum entrance, choose one work each, and compare what caught your attention before walking back across Newcomb Quad.
cards.short_summary: A campus art stop with always-free admission.
cards.evidence_claim: Admission to Newcomb Art Museum is always free; it is located in the Woldenberg Art Center on Tulane's Uptown Campus.
cards.access_notes: Free admission; check the museum visit page for current opening dates and hours.

cards.entity_name: Sydney and Walda Besthoff Sculpture Garden
cards.title: Walk the Besthoff Sculpture Garden
cards.subtitle: New Orleans City Park
cards.notes: Take the garden map, follow the paths around the lagoons, and pause at a few sculptures to trade interpretations or take photos together.
cards.short_summary: A free outdoor collection of more than 90 sculptures.
cards.evidence_claim: The Sydney and Walda Besthoff Sculpture Garden has free admission and is open seven days a week.
cards.source_title: Sydney and Walda Besthoff Sculpture Garden
cards.access_notes: Free admission; follow the garden's posted hours and safety guidance.

cards.title: Settle into City Park
cards.subtitle: 1 Palm Drive, New Orleans
cards.notes: Bring water and a blanket, pick an open patch of lawn, and use the park grounds as a relaxed meet-up point before choosing a walking route.
cards.short_summary: The park grounds are free to enter year-round.
cards.evidence_claim: New Orleans City Park is free to enter, and its grounds are open sunrise to sunset every day.
cards.source_title: Things to Do at New Orleans City Park
cards.access_notes: The grounds are free; individual attractions may charge separately.

cards.title: Take a Couturie Forest loop
cards.subtitle: New Orleans City Park
cards.notes: Wear closed-toe shoes, choose a daylight loop, and keep the group together while you look for native plants and birds along the forest trails.
cards.short_summary: A City Park forest area listed among its free activities.
cards.evidence_claim: City Park lists Couturie Forest and Scout Island among activities that are completely free and need no tickets or reservations.
cards.source_title: Things to Do at New Orleans City Park
cards.access_notes: Free outdoor activity; go in daylight and use established paths.

cards.title: Circle Big Lake
cards.subtitle: New Orleans City Park
cards.notes: Walk the lake path at an easy pace, pause to watch waterfowl, and bring a camera or sketchbook instead of planning a paid attraction.
cards.short_summary: A free lake-and-path stop inside City Park.
cards.evidence_claim: City Park identifies Big Lake as a free activity and describes a scenic walking path around the lake.
cards.source_title: Free Things to Do at City Park
cards.access_notes: Free to visit; fishing requires a Louisiana license.

cards.title: Play a casual disc-golf round
cards.subtitle: New Orleans City Park
cards.notes: Bring discs from home, agree on a short round, and let newcomers throw from closer tees so everyone can join without keeping score too seriously.
cards.short_summary: City Park lists disc golf as a no-cost activity when you bring discs.
cards.evidence_claim: City Park lists disc golf among its free activities and notes that visitors can bring their own discs.
cards.source_title: Free Things to Do at City Park
cards.access_notes: No ticket or reservation is required; bring your own discs.

cards.title: Try the Greenway fitness stations
cards.subtitle: Lafitte Greenway, New Orleans
cards.notes: Make a gentle circuit of the outdoor equipment, take turns picking a movement, and keep it conversational rather than treating it like a formal workout.
cards.short_summary: A free NORD outdoor fitness location for adults.
cards.evidence_claim: NORD lists the Lafitte Greenway Outdoor Fitness Park among its free fitness centers, open to people age 18 and older.
cards.access_notes: Free access for ages 18+; verify current facility hours before traveling.

cards.title: Picnic under the Audubon Park oaks
cards.subtitle: 6500 Magazine Street, New Orleans
cards.notes: Bring a homemade snack or just a blanket, choose an open area under the live oaks, and use the park as a daytime conversation stop.
cards.short_summary: A public Uptown park with paths, lagoon, and picnic areas.
cards.evidence_claim: Audubon Park is open to the public and includes live-oak groves, a lagoon, picnic pavilions, and a jogging path.
cards.access_notes: Public park; the official page lists daily operating hours of 5 a.m.–10 p.m.

cards.entity_name: Audubon Zoo Orleans Parish Appreciation Days
cards.title: Visit Audubon Zoo on a free resident day
cards.subtitle: Audubon Zoo, 6500 Magazine Street
cards.notes: Confirm the rotating appreciation-day calendar, bring a Tulane ID if you live in Orleans Parish, and plan the visit with up to four guests.
cards.short_summary: Select monthly free-admission dates for Orleans Parish residents.
cards.evidence_claim: On select appreciation days, Orleans Parish residents receive free admission to Audubon Zoo; a current college ID is valid residency proof for students living in Orleans Parish.
cards.access_notes: Free only on scheduled appreciation days for eligible Orleans Parish residents; confirm the 2026 calendar.

cards.entity_name: Audubon Aquarium Orleans Parish Appreciation Days
cards.title: Visit Audubon Aquarium on a free resident day
cards.subtitle: Audubon Aquarium, 1 Canal Street
cards.notes: Check which date is assigned to the Aquarium, bring qualifying Orleans Parish residency ID, and meet outside before going in together.
cards.short_summary: A scheduled free-admission option for eligible local students.
cards.evidence_claim: Audubon Community Connect provides Orleans Parish residents free admission to Audubon Aquarium on certain days each month; current college IDs qualify students living in Orleans Parish.
cards.access_notes: Free only on scheduled appreciation days for eligible Orleans Parish residents; confirm the 2026 calendar.
